courses.note: Elective: the major requires one course from CS 325, 329, 334 or 377 (a choice, not a required AI course). CS 325 is the introductory AI course and is scheduled most terms (Fall 2024 to Spring 2026 per coursicle); CS 334 is the alternative. The only public syllabus is the 2015 course wiki, which predates ChatGPT; no current syllabus was public.
